## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem this fixes and how the application behaves after the change.
Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

Record the checks you ran and their results. For calculation changes, include an
independent expected result. Distinguish fixtures/local checks from real plant verification.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] I checked relevant balances, units, uncertainty, observability, and storage behavior.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated, or no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] No credentials, private certificates, plant-confidential data, or runtime files are included.
- [ ] I have described any incomplete checks, risks, or limitations above.

The maintainer reviews and merges this pull request after the required checks pass.
